policy.hierarchical_action: Bernoulli irrigation gate plus active-only tanh-Gaussian amount_fraction
policy.fairness_rule: For the same seed, actor and reward critic architecture and initial parameters must exactly match PPO v1. Extra capacity is limited to the risk critic and three scalar dual multipliers.

objective.primary: maximize expected water return, equivalently minimize expected controllable postplant irrigation

risk_constraint.grouping: Each eta is estimated independently from exactly 18 equally weighted training weather-year episodes per update.
risk_constraint.tau_estimator: For each eta and update, tau is the empirical lower-alpha quantile: the ceil(alpha*n)-th smallest retention. With n=18 and alpha=0.20 this is the fourth-smallest retention.
risk_constraint.actor_risk_constant_omitted: The eta-tau term is constant with respect to the action distribution when tau is frozen at the batch optimum; by the envelope argument it is omitted from the actor/risk-critic return to avoid score-function variance.
risk_constraint.exact_contract_check: The Rockafellar-Uryasev value at empirical tau must numerically equal the exact fractional order-statistic estimator from awm-risk-contract-v1.

lagrangian.primal_order: Freeze lambda_k, tau_k and all tail assignments for the complete PPO update; update actor/reward critic/risk critic; then update duals to lambda_{k+1}.

optimizer.name: Adam
optimizer.advantage_normalization: standardize combined actor advantage after eta-specific dual weighting

rollout.risk_assignment_time: after all 54 episodes are collected and before PPO optimization

interaction_budget.fairness_rule: Exactly the same maximum training interaction budget as PPO v1 and PPO-Lagrangian v1; risk estimation and dual updates use only the existing 54 rollout episodes.

change_rule: Any change to alpha, empirical tau semantics, actor risk signal, dual hyperparameters, architecture, optimizer, interaction budget, seeds, checkpoint cadence or evaluation action mode after formal RCWA-RL training begins requires a new RCWA protocol version.
